### TRAVEL TUMBLER 经典保温杯 500ml 白色

[![Image 19](http://www.kintocn.cn/uploads/2019/0606/1559800406.2362.jpg) For a comfortable drinking experience wherever you go The vacuum insulated TRAVEL TUMBLER is designed for people who lead a conscious and flexible lifestyle—for those who appreciate the subtle flavors of drinks at the temperature that is just right for your body. 随时随地舒适饮用体验--经典保温杯 真空隔热保温被专为为了出行方便籍可以享受到随身饮用冷热饮具有灵活生活态度的人士而设计，不同于以往保温杯的一贯保温效果，保温更要饮品温度适宜饮用。](https://www.kintocn.cn/product/detail_299.html)

[![Image 20](http://www.kintocn.cn/uploads/2019/0606/1559800414.0724.jpg) STRESS-FREE DRINKING The cap is simple without excess details and you can drink from any angle pleasantly, like drinking out of a glass or mug. A special structure catches ice cubes and drinks come out in perfect amount. 轻松饮用 经典保温杯的杯口部设计没有繁复的结构，允许您如从马克杯中饮水一样轻松。特殊设计的出水杯口结构可以保证饮用时滤出冰块，饮用量洽当。](https://www.kintocn.cn/product/detail_299.html)

[![Image 21](http://www.kintocn.cn/uploads/2019/0606/1559800421.436.jpg) VACUUM INSULATED Double walled stainless steel tumbler prevents heat transfer with a vacuum between its inner and outer walls. The foil layer covering the inner wall reflects heat back inside, contributing to excellent heat and cold retention. 真空隔热 双层不锈钢真空结构，保证热量在不锈钢内外壁间无传到。电镀内胆可以让热量在杯身内反射，无热量损失，可以达到保温，保冷效果。](https://www.kintocn.cn/product/detail_299.html)

[![Image 22](http://www.kintocn.cn/uploads/2019/0606/1559800429.3445.jpg) DURABLE MATERIAL In addition to usability, material and texture support long-term use. Made of durable 18-8 stainless steel, the tumbler does not rust easily. The colored tumblers have a powder coat finish on the surface which prevents scratches. 持久材质 18-8结构不锈钢材料应用，可以保证经典保温杯的材料材质长时间使用，同时保温杯内胆不会生锈，借助外壁涂层经典保温杯外壁不易划伤 。](https://www.kintocn.cn/product/detail_299.html)

[![Image 23](http://www.kintocn.cn/uploads/2019/0606/1559800438.3448.jpg) CLEAN & FRESH High quality stainless steel helps to preserve the rich aroma and flavor of drinks. The smooth electro-polished interior prevents odors and stains, letting you maintain it clean and fresh. 清新洁净 高品质不锈钢材质的应用感，保证饮品的丰富风味及口感。电镀内胆防止异味及污物的产生，并保持经典保温杯的清新洁净。](https://www.kintocn.cn/product/detail_299.html)
